name: What is typically included in a full garage remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is typically included in a full garage remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage renovation scope typically includes framing interior walls, hanging and finishing drywall, adding insulation, updating trim, painting, and installing specialized storage or workbenches. If your project includes dedicated workshops or extra lighting, sub-trades are coordinated to run electrical wiring or rough in plumbing. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra directly oversees the carpentry, drywall, and paint work while managing specialty trades, ensuring structural framing and utility additions align smoothly before final finishes are installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full remodel covers framing, drywall, insulation, painting, and trim, along with coordinated electrical or plumbing additions for workshops or living space conversions.
